verdict.rationale: n8n is a workflow automation tool that runs workflows and multi-step agents unattended: webhook triggers start them, error workflows handle failures, and hands-on users report scheduled and webhook-initiated tasks running in production at scale (millions of workflows a year). Missing for 10: first-party documentation of scheduling or cron triggers (the evidence for recurring schedules is community-only), and detail on background execution or queueing behavior.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: n8n is a fair-code licensed workflow automation tool that combines AI features with business process automation.
Build and operationalize AI workflows and multi-step agents using your own data, models, and tools
Currently my team use it for processing millions of workflows each year on a very small server
With an error workflow, you can control how n8n responds to a workflow execution failure.
